verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents identity and payment tokens (kya, pay, kya-pay), token charging and introspection, and MCP tools for finding sellers and creating tokens. Nothing in the evidence shows a protocol call that creates or updates a cart or order draft. Token creation and charging are an adjacent payment-authorization capability, not cart or order-draft management, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can create and update a cart or order draft through a documented protocol call
